CustomProperties.Name: AccentColor
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Primary accent color for selected items, badges, and highlights.

CustomProperties.Name: AppLogo
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Logo image for the header mark. When blank, shows the first letter of AppName.

CustomProperties.Name: AppName
CustomProperties.Tooltip: First word of the app name shown in the header when expanded.

CustomProperties.Name: AppNameAccent
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Second word of the app name rendered in AccentColor. e.g. "UI".

CustomProperties.Name: Expanded
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Initial expanded state on load. On screen OnVisible run Set(_cmpNavIsExpanded true); Set(_cmpNavSelID 11); ClearCollect(colNavExpanded {ID:1})

CustomProperties.Name: Icons
CustomProperties.Tooltip: SVG icon library as a table of {Name, SVG} pairs. Reference icons in Items by name string e.g. Icon:"Grid". SVGs use stroke='white' so they work on both dark and light icon backgrounds. Extend with your own icons — any Heroicons or Lucide SVG with stroke='white' works.

CustomProperties.Name: IsExpanded
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Mirrors Expanded. Use to offset your screen content — e.g. X = cmpSidebar.Width.

CustomProperties.Name: Items
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Table driving the nav. Schema: {ID:Number, Title:Text, Icon:Image, Letter:Text, Badge:Number, BadgeColor:Color, BadgeDot:Boolean, IsSection:Boolean, ParentID:Number, Visible:Boolean} Icon accepts an Image value or a base64 SVG data URI string cast to Image. Letter overrides the auto-initial fallback when Icon is blank — e.g. Letter:"DB" shows "DB". Set IsSection=true for divider/label rows. Set Badge=0 to hide badge. BadgeColor overrides the badge fill per item — defaults to AccentColor. BadgeDot=true shows a small dot instead of the number (good for unread indicators). Set ParentID to the parent item's ID for child items, or -1 for root level. Set Visible=false to hide an item — useful for role-based access. Sections are automatically hidden when all of their child items are hidden.

CustomProperties.Name: OnFooterSettings
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user taps Settings in the footer menu.

CustomProperties.Name: OnHelp
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user taps Help in the footer menu.

CustomProperties.Name: OnNavSelect
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when a nav item is tapped. Read SelectedID output to identify the item.

CustomProperties.Name: OnThemeToggle
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user taps the Theme button in the footer menu. Toggle your Theme variable here — e.g. Set(gTheme, If(gTheme="Dark","Light","Dark")).

CustomProperties.Name: OnToggle
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the expand/collapse button is pressed. Flip your Expanded variable here — e.g. Set(gNavExpanded, !gNavExpanded).

CustomProperties.Name: SelectedID
CustomProperties.Tooltip: ID of the most recently selected nav item. Initialize _cmpNavSelID on your screen's OnVisible to set the default.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowFooterMenu
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Show a context menu on the footer with Settings, Help, and Theme toggle.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowHeader
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Show the logo + app name header at the top of the nav.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowSearch
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Show a search bar below the header (only visible when expanded).

CustomProperties.Name: ShowToggle
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Show the expand/collapse toggle pill on the right edge of the nav.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowUser
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Show the current user's initials and name at the bottom of the nav.

CustomProperties.Name: Theme
CustomProperties.Tooltip: "Dark" or "Light". Controls all background, text, border, and hover colors.

If(
  ThisItem.ParentID > -1 &&
  !IsBlank(LookUp(
    Filter(cmpSidebar.Items, ParentID = ThisItem.ParentID),
    ID > ThisItem.ID
  )),
  42,
  21
)

If(
  ThisItem.ID = _cmpNavSelID,
  cmpSidebar.AccentColor,
  If(cmpSidebar.Theme = "Dark",
    RGBA(185, 185, 210, 1),
    RGBA(30, 40, 75, 1))
)

If(ThisItem.ParentID > -1,
  If(cmpSidebar.Theme = "Dark",
    RGBA(79, 142, 247, 0.06),
    RGBA(79, 142, 247, 0.06)),
  If(cmpSidebar.Theme = "Dark",
    ColorFade(cmpSidebar.AccentColor, 0.82),
    RGBA(219, 234, 254, 1)))

If(
  ThisItem.ID = _cmpNavSelID,
  cmpSidebar.AccentColor,
  If(cmpSidebar.Theme = "Dark",
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    RGBA(79, 142, 247, 0.75))
)

If(
  IsBlank(ThisItem.Icon) || ThisItem.Icon = "",
  Blank(),
  "data:image/svg+xml," & EncodeUrl(
    LookUp(cmpSidebar.Icons, Name = ThisItem.Icon, SVG)
  )
)

If(
  IsBlank(ThisItem.BadgeColor) || ThisItem.BadgeColor = RGBA(0,0,0,0),
  cmpSidebar.AccentColor,
  ThisItem.BadgeColor
)

If(
  IsBlank(ThisItem.BadgeColor) || ThisItem.BadgeColor = RGBA(0,0,0,0),
  cmpSidebar.AccentColor,
  ThisItem.BadgeColor
)
